scope.criteria: One entry requires exact tip/merge base, source patch inspection, actual current replacement or missing-behavior evidence, qualification limits, and a port recommendation. It is not exhaustive full-branch certification.

method: Inspect merge-base-to-tip source patches and tip-to-current source differences; retain exact paths/blobs and git cherry results.
Use file/AST equality as local evidence only; inspect changed implementation and its consumer before claiming focal behavior is retained.
Run selected current regression suites and actual SQLite/normalized-graph/CLI negative controls; retain failures without changing current source.
Do not reclassify native/research or uninspected inherited source by a branch title, merged PR status, patch ID or passing unrelated tests.
excluded_as_separately_owned: accepted CVRF/pilot/staleness bridge and row/budget repairs
counting: Gate results are listed separately. Shared tests mapped to multiple branches are not additive evidence or a completion denominator.

candidates.title: Report capped callgraph views as partial and deduplicate focus inputs
candidates.observation: The real cycle_hub view shows 64 of 66 neighbours, retains a MoreMarker, but has truncated=False. Two CLI format controls fail at neighbours returning exit 0/ok. Duplicate focus IDs can consume the root budget and hide another root. The below-cap duplicate-claims control passes.
candidates.acceptance: Propagate per-origin omission into conservative partial state/limits, CLI exit, JSON/DOT and desktop text. Preserve below-cap complete behavior and exact per-origin counts. The original failing assertions stop before later export assertions; export and UI acceptance must be executed after repair, not inferred from this red run.

candidates.title: Share the path-query work budget across prepasses and avoid whole-graph/row copies
candidates.observation: A caller budget of 40 allows 202 adjacency examinations in the reverse-prepass control. The actual normalized 816-node hub query copies 200145 adjacency entries. find_paths rebuilds the complete CSR; an already-cancelled query still copies/reads 859 entries before refusal. The normal shortest/tie-order positive passes.
candidates.acceptance: Bound actual adjacency examinations across shortest, reverse and enumeration phases; check cancellation before work and during scans; preserve shortest lexical order, the five-path/length caps, listed-membership and endpoint rules, and a completed shortest witness on later exhaustion. Independently review this algorithmic port.

candidates.title: Recover an updated synthetic F8 packaged journey
candidates.observation: The historical helper exercised offline advisory import, ambiguity/explicit scope, pair preview/create/adopt, fixture import/rank, candidates, export, Unicode paths, reopen and stale-reopen using the normal event loop. Current --self-test checks a sample window and panel construction. Separate current pytest journeys cover many components, but do not replace that packaged end-to-end journey.
candidates.acceptance: Adapt the journey to current contracts and packaging in a separate reviewed slice. Keep synthetic labeling, no target/network execution, bounded event-loop cleanup, and real frozen Windows/Linux runs distinct from source offscreen tests.

candidates.title: Explicit bounded recovery of partially created projects
candidates.observation: The historical workflow privately staged artifacts/snapshot and offered an explicit check-and-retry action with byte identity, entry/schema bounds and owner/revision checks.
